server.note: Started with 'npm run dev -- --port 5173 --strictPort' from D:\personal\Photo\composition; Vite announced http://localhost:5173/. Stopped with TaskStop and doctor.mjs stop (free_after: true). The Vite log shows one 'file watcher error: EBUSY' on .devflow/evidence/feat-album-builder/AC-7.20.zip while Playwright saved the download into the watched project tree; this is a server-side watcher message, not a browser console error or a 5xx. AC-7.23 ran in a separate headless Playwright WebKit 27.2 instance with devices['iPhone 13'] against the same server; all other checks ran in the MCP Chromium page.

preconditions.what: The phase-7 export dialog exists: in a new album, the top-bar button data-testid=action-export opens data-testid=export-dialog titled 'Експорт для друку' with the options 'Розвороти цілком (файлів: 15)' and 'Окремі сторінки (файлів: 30)'
preconditions.evidence: browser_run_code result: {title: 'Експорт для друку', kinds: [export-kind-spreads (15), export-kind-pages (30)]}

assertions.then: a warning names the page count 22 and the minimum of 24
assertions.actual: Given: new album, 4 of 15 non-cover spreads removed (11 left). warning-min-pages: 'Сторінок для друку: 22. Потрібно щонайменше 24.' Options read 'файлів: 11' and 'файлів: 22', so the cover is not counted.

assertions.then: a warning names the low-dpi cell on spread 1
assertions.actual: land-1.jpg imported through the add-photos file chooser and placed on spread 1, template full. warning-low-dpi: 'Низька якість: розворот 1, комірка 1 — 75 dpi (потрібно щонайменше 200).'

assertions.then: a warning names the empty cell on spread 2
assertions.actual: warning-empty-cell: 'Порожня комірка: розворот 2, комірка 1.' (15 warnings in total, the other 13 are the empty cells of spreads 3-15)

assertions.then: a warning names the photo on the half that is not printed
assertions.actual: Book start set in the Settings dialog to 'Сторінка 1 — окрема права сторінка' (settings.bookStart = single-right); land-1.jpg in cell 1 (left half) of spread 1, template two. warning-unprinted-photo: 'Фото на половині, що не друкується: розворот 1, комірка 1.'

assertions.then: a warning names the missing photo
assertions.actual: A photo meta 'ghost-from-layout.jpg' with no stored preview and no original was added through the store (addPhotos) and placed on spread 2, which is the state a layout file opened without its photos produces. warning-missing-photo: 'Немає фото: ghost-from-layout.jpg.'

assertions.then: showDirectoryPicker is called with mode readwrite
assertions.actual: Page-side stub recorded exactly one call with {mode: 'readwrite'}; it returned an in-memory folder, and the export wrote export-Новий альбом/spreads/spread-01.jpg, pages/page-001.jpg, pages/page-002.jpg into it; data-testid=export-done appeared.
page 'download' listener recorded 0 downloads through export-done.
With an init script deleting window.showDirectoryPicker before load ('showDirectoryPicker' in window = false), one download 'export-Новий альбом.zip' in 7.3 s; export-done shown.

assertions.then: spreads/spread-01.jpg is 7157x3614 px and its header gives 300 dpi
assertions.actual: spread-01.jpg: 7157x3614, APP0 JFIF units=1 density 300x300. All 15 spreads 7157x3614, all 45 files JFIF 1:300x300.

assertions.then: no file in the ZIP is the cover
assertions.actual: 45 entries = spreads/spread-01..15 + pages/page-001..030; no cover entry; the album has 16 spreads including the cover.

assertions.then: the bleed on the fold side of each page holds the image of the neighbouring page
assertions.actual: Decoded page-001 and page-002 of the AC-7.20 ZIP. The 71 px (6 mm) fold-side strip of page-001 vs the same-mm strip of page-002: mean abs diff 0.04 per channel; vs a mirrored strip 5.69; vs the outer edge 40.3; background-colour (#f4efe6) fraction 0 in both strips.

assertions.then: the app asks the user to choose the original files
assertions.actual: After a full page load of the album from AC-7.20 (originals no longer in memory), export-start gave export-need-originals: 'Для експорту потрібні оригінальні файли фото (1). Оберіть їх.' No export-error.

assertions.then: after the choice the export completes
assertions.actual: export-choose-originals -> file chooser -> land-1.jpg -> 'Оригінали знайдено.' -> export-continue -> one ZIP download, export-done. 45 entries, same sizes; spread-01.jpg byte-identical (sha256 prefix 4a4a2894e85b0a2e) to the AC-7.20 export, so the cells are not blank.

assertions.then: a note says that full-quality export of whole spreads works on a computer
assertions.actual: WebKit 27.2, devices['iPhone 13'] (editor class 'editor mobile', pointer coarse). export-phone-note: 'На телефоні можна експортувати лише окремі сторінки. Повноякісний експорт цілих розворотів працює на комп’ютері.'

assertions.then: only the pages option is offered
every request in the network log goes to the app origin
assertions.actual: Network log of the AC-7.20 page from load through the ZIP export (static included): 59 requests, 55 to http://localhost:5173 and 4 to blob:http://localhost:5173/...; no other origin.

regression_sweep.surface: album list (‹ Альбоми): list loads and an older album opens in the editor
